method: Actual main and recovery helper with explicit DOM/cache/storage fault boundaries. No actual browser quota or actual loaded-model inference assertion is inferred from these tests; root browser evidence is separate.

checks.name: Reclamation removes only recognized public-model entries, retains loaded engine/unknown/user caches
Actual main retries identical atomic mutation once after quota reclamation and marks offline unavailable
Second quota failure stops after one retry and retains dirty state
SecurityError never deletes caches and is never automatically retried
InvalidStateError never deletes caches and is never automatically retried
DataCloneError never deletes caches and is never automatically retried
Absent model cache cannot turn quota failure into a false success
